skills.name: create_file
skills.purpose: Creates a new file with optional initial content.
when_to_use: Creating new source files during project scaffolding

parameters.name: file_path
parameters.description: Full path to the file to create. Parent directories are created automatically if they don't exist.

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: Initial content to write to the file. Defaults to empty string.

skills.example:
```
create_file("src/main.py", "print('Hello, World!')")
```

Creates `src/main.py` with the content `print('Hello, World!')`.

skills.name: create_folder
skills.purpose: Creates a directory at the specified path.
when_to_use: Creating output directories before writing files

parameters.name: folder_path
parameters.description: Full path of the directory to create. Parent directories are created automatically if they don't exist.

skills.example:
```
create_folder("src/components")
```

Creates `src/components/` directory (and `src/` if it doesn't exist).
skills.returns: - Success message with the created path

skills.name: get_current_date
skills.purpose: Returns the real current date as a formatted string.
when_to_use: When the user asks "what day is it?"
When the agent needs to know the current date for calculations

skills.name: read_file
skills.purpose: Reads and returns the contents of a text file.
when_to_use: Inspecting the contents of a source file
Checking if a file exists and what it contains

parameters.name: file_path
parameters.description: Full path to the file to read.

skills.example:
```
read_file("src/main.py")
```

Returns the full text content of `src/main.py`.
skills.returns:
- The file's text content as a string
- An error message if the file does not exist

skills.name: read_pdf
skills.purpose: Extracts text contents from a PDF file.

parameters.name: pdf_path
parameters.description: Full path to the PDF file to read.

skills.example:
```
read_pdf("documents/report.pdf")
```

Returns the extracted text content from all pages of the PDF.
skills.returns:
- The extracted text content as a string
- An error message if `pypdf` is not installed or the file doesn't exist
skills.requirements: - The `pypdf` library must be installed (`pip install pypdf`)

skills.name: setup_venv
when_to_use: Setting up a new Python project
Creating a clean Python environment for testing
Preparing a project before installing packages

parameters.name: env_dir
parameters.description: Path where the virtual environment will be created. Defaults to `.venv` in the current directory.

skills.example:
```
setup_venv(".venv")
```

Creates a `.venv/` directory with Python's virtual environment inside.
skills.returns: - Success message with the path to the created environment

skills.name: tell_me_the_date_and_time
skills.purpose: Returns the current date and time.
when_to_use: When the user asks "what time is it?"
When the agent needs both date and time together
skills.example:
```
tell_me_the_date_and_time()
```

Returns something like: `The current date and time is 2026-08-19 18:30:00`
skills.returns: - A string with the current date and time

skills.name: write_file
skills.purpose: Writes or overwrites text content to a file.
when_to_use: Overwriting configuration files with new values
Saving generated output to a file

parameters.name: file_path
parameters.description: Full path to the file to write.

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: The content to write to the file.

skills.example:
```
write_file("config/settings.json", '{"theme": "dark"}')
```

Writes `{"theme": "dark"}` to `config/settings.json`, overwriting any existing content.
